svg.title: Grant matching — system context
svg.desc: How a funding opportunity travels from its source to a researcher's screen: ReciterAI's pipeline_grants fetches, judges, and persists the corpus into account-shared stores (DynamoDB reciterai + S3), SPS's nightly projection mirrors it into Aurora and the scholars-opportunities index, and the Grant Matcha surfaces serve it — with a staff intake loop and a weekly Research Dean funding digest feeding URLs back into the same pipeline, and freshness guardrails watching the whole supply chain.

g.title: WCM funding DB — curated CSV · crawler retired
Funding digest — Research Dean weekly email (SES -> S3); etl:funding-digest · stricter dedup
Development-office staff — paste opportunity URLs into /edit
Bedrock judge / scorer — is_research · relevance · topic scores
DynamoDB · reciterai — GRANT# corpus items; SUBMISSION queue (/edit + digest)
S3 · wcmc-reciterai-artifacts — grants/latest — sweep-only publish; manifest.json read nightly by SPS
SPS nightly projection — etl:dynamodb · cron(0 7 * * ? *); staging 07:45 · offset from prod InfoEd
Aurora · opportunity — suppressedAt survives every upsert
/edit/grant-matcha — Browse + suppress · Submissions intake; opportunity detail · seeded Matcha ask
Freshness guardrails — OpportunityCorpusIngestAgeDays; >= 21 days -> etl-failures topic; + ReciterAI-grants row · /edit/etl-status
